source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/13-admin.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p13"; README screen 13
notes: Region-composition check for the full page: AppShell + the real AdminDashboard (its own internal Masthead), populated fixture data via .discipline/rendering/audit/mounts.mjs['compose-admin'], no live Supabase project reachable in this sandbox (DEVIATION-LOG.md). The mount now seeds dc.html p13's own four provisional rows as real ProvisionalSource records, so the default landing region renders with data rather than its empty state.

Artboard order, top to bottom: Masthead -> 8-tile stat grid (Workspaces/Sources/Ingest/Coverage/Research pipeline/Community pickups/Runtime/Emission factors), Sources tile SELECTED -> Sources sub-tab bar, 'Provisional review' FIRST and active -> the SOURCES · PROVISIONAL REVIEW card (head, SOURCE/TIER/STATUS/DISCOVERED table with a per-row Approve and the trailing overflow, legend foot, pipeline note) -> Organizations card. Rail, top to bottom: Issues queue, the Companies/Individuals/Newest join/Active-this-month card, Read-only controls.

Lane comp-admin (2026-09-08) closed the region the previous pass logged as NOT FIXED: SourceHealthDashboard's Provisional view rendered a 'Source Intelligence' module (its own header, a B.2 progress bar, a Source Tiers legend, a T1-T7 tile grid, a SECOND tab bar, a source search) where the artboard draws one table card. That view is now the artboard's card, built from the shared parts (SectionRule + the new shared ui/RowTable + TierChip + StateNote + Absence); the module's other views (registry/health/canonical/intersections/themes/obligations), which have no artboard, are untouched. The forbid list below is what stops the old composition coming back.

Actions stay real: Approve/Reject/Re-tier all POST /api/admin/sources/promote, the endpoint the review flow already owned (approve/reject/defer). 'Re-tier = stays provisional' is the artboard's own legend and is exactly what decision 'defer' does, there is no in-place tier write for a provisional row (commit-tier-change returns 409 for kind:"provisional").

Two artboard details are deliberately NOT asserted, both logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md 2026-09-08: the foot's 'All 489 provisional' LINK (the built card is the whole queue, so a link to a fuller list would be a dead control, ruling 1.1, and the text renders the live count instead), and the rail's 'Export queue' button (no queue-export endpoint exists anywhere under src/app/api/admin/; not drawn dead, not invented).

Also NOT asserted, logged: the artboard puts the Sources sub-tab row INSIDE the card head; the build keeps AdminDashboard's one sub-nav above the card, because that row is shared by all seven admin sections and moving it inside is a page-shell restructure beyond this pass.
OrganizationsTable's own row anatomy is still its pre-handoff one (fix58-account's 2026-09-07 DEVIATION-LOG entry left it as-is); region 6 asserts the card is present and in place, not its internals.
